game_title: Reverse Parade – Fallen Statue Garden Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Reverse Parade: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Reverse the order of a parade list with reverse() or slicing. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the spirit seeker ahead. Then check the parade_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ancient lock by solving code steps involving parade_ok that move the spirit seeker forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ancient lock first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Reverse Parade
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Parade' (Week 7 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Fallen Statue Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how parade_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Fallen Statue Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
